title: Generative Design with Real-time Physics Explainability: Towards Product Definition in the Age of AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.17560v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this article, we explore opportunities from using generative AI in mechanical engineering. On the one hand, generative methods based on invertible neural networks have been recently proposed for the solution of inverse design problems, allowing to infer design parameters from performance labels. On the other hand, generative AI models have shown that they can act as real time capable surrogates for physics based simulations. Here we suggest that these two streams should be combined in a unified framework, where INN are used to control the design process from the customer requirements perspective and the generative simulation of the systems physics adds a layer of explainability, why the proposed design fulfils the requirements. As generative design is prone to hallucinations, we propose uncertainty quantification to fend off physically infeasible requests. Finally, validation with classical tools is a requirement for generative design

translated_title: 具有实时物理可解释性的生成式设计：迈向人工智能时代的产品定义
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们探讨了在机械工程领域应用生成式人工智能的机遇。一方面，近年来基于可逆神经网络的生成式方法被提出用于求解逆向设计问题，能够从性能标签推断出设计参数。另一方面，生成式人工智能模型已证明其可作为基于物理的仿真的实时替代模型。在此，我们建议将这两条技术路线结合到一个统一框架中：可逆神经网络用于从客户需求的角度控制设计过程，而系统物理的生成式仿真则增加了一层可解释性，用以说明所提出的设计为何能够满足需求。鉴于生成式设计容易产生幻觉，我们提出利用不确定性量化来防范物理上不可行的请求。最后，采用经典工具进行验证是生成式设计的必要要求。
tldr: 提出将基于可逆神经网络的逆向设计与实时生成式物理仿真相结合的统一生成式设计框架，借助不确定性量化和经典工具验证来确保设计的物理可行性与可解释性。
en_tdlr: Proposes a unified generative design framework that combines invertible neural network-based inverse design with real-time generative physics simulation for explainability, using uncertainty quantification and classical validation to ensure physical feasibility.
